clarification.ublgbp_meaning: primary balance adjusted for the cyclical component
clarification.structural_relation: Structural primary balance corresponds to cyclically adjusted primary balance excluding one-off and other temporary measures.
source_basis: European Commission fiscal-document definition of structural (primary) balance as cyclically adjusted (primary) balance excluding one-off and temporary measures
European Commission Discussion Paper 181 Annex 2 listing UBLGBP as primary balance, cyclically adjusted

governance.reason: Historical filenames are retained for provenance, but current and future prose must not conflate UBLGBPS with generic cyclically adjusted primary balance.

modeling_implication.reason: A structural-primary target already removes the estimated cyclical component and one-off measures. Any future inclusion of output-gap terms requires a new theoretical and identification rationale rather than inheritance from the failed nominal-primary-balance form.
